verdict.rationale: Warp documents registrable outbound webhooks: it sends an HTTPS POST to your endpoint for each subscribed event. Deliveries follow the Standard Webhooks spec, retry up to 12 times with exponential backoff, and can be verified with the TypeScript or Go SDKs, which is enough to drive downstream automations. The docs only say webhooks fire 'when data changes in Warp' and never list the specific events this story names. Missing for 10: a documented event catalog confirming payroll-processed, employee-onboarded and payment-failed events, and independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery.
